description: The geospatial information portal of CONAE, the Argentine national space agency, gives access to thematic viewers and catalogues of its Earth observation products. The viewers listed on the portal cover emergency activations, fire hotspots, high-resolution images, provincial mosaics from the SAOCOM 1 radar satellites, the SAOCOM 1 acquisition plan, PROSAT II products and marine application products. The portal also links the CONAE catalogue home page, metadata geocatalogues and a catalogue of OGC geoservices for use in GIS software. Access to the viewers and catalogues is free online; no licence is stated on the portal page read. Caveats: the portal is in Spanish and its viewers are MapStore applications that load by script, so product details sit in the catalogues. Coverage is Argentina. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response analysis, such as fire and flood monitoring around infrastructure, and radar-based ground deformation work; related records are CNES GEODES, JAXA G-Portal and Digital Earth Australia.
